description: Testfeld A4: Messwerte Umfeld- und Verkehrsdaten is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesanstalt für Straßenwesen (BASt). The environmental data provided here record the state of the atmosphere (precipitation, relative humidity, wind, etc.) and the road surface (road surface temperature, water film thickness, etc.) on the test field A4 of the BASt. Coverage: Bundesanstalt für Straßenwesen (BASt). The portal shows the English title as "Test field A4: Measured environmental and traffic data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Bundesanstalt für Straßenwesen (BASt). The listing shows 2024-07-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
